quest.title: City of Freedom
quest.description: With your help, the problem was resolved quickly. Led by Amber, you reach the city of freedom — Mondstadt.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Mora x1625, Character EXP x850, Enhancement Ore x7

chapter.title: The Outlander Who Caught the Wind

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Let me officially introduce the city of wind, dandelions, and freedom —

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Travelers under the protection of the Knights of Favonius — Welcome to Mondstadt!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Finally, no more having to camp outdoors!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But... the city folk don't look too cheery.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Everyone's been put out of place by Stormterror recently.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: But everything will turn out fine as long as Jean's with us!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Acting Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius — Jean, Defender of Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: With Jean on our side, surely even the vicious Stormterror will be no match for us.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: #Before I take you guys to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters, I have a present for you, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: It's a reward for helping me clear out that hilichurl camp.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He-Hey! Why doesn't Paimon get a reward?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Ahh... Because this reward is useless to you, Paimon.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: But I'll treat you to a traditional Mondstadt delicacy — Sticky Honey Roast.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Come with me, we'll head to the city's ahh... <color=#00E1FFFF>high ground</color>.

choices.text: (I hope she knows something about the God of Anemo)

talks.objective: Go to the location designated by Amber

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: So, the present I want to give you is...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Outriders use them to ride the wind, and the people of Mondstadt love using them too.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: I brought you here to give it to you so you can experience it right away!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, you're really excited about these wind gliders, huh!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Well that's because the wind is the heart and soul of Mondstadt!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Alrighty then, enough talk! Let's give it a whirl!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: It's easy to use, but you still need to pay attention to my instructions.

talks.objective: Meet Amber at the fountain plaza
